main_5min.purpose: Explain the GreenPulse end-to-end system in one visual.
Show measured Tomato and Bell Pepper evidence immediately.
Demonstrate that uncertain or failed inputs do not trigger blind action.
Prove engineering maturity with API, contracts, tests and real-test infrastructure.
Present remaining hardware/scientific validation as a controlled evidence campaign.
Close with the three strongest GreenPulse pillars.

backup_qa.use_when: Jury asks for direct model metric comparison.
Jury asks whether backend/hardware teams can integrate the project.
Jury asks what is measured versus software validated versus pending.
Jury asks for detailed architecture/layer completion status.
Jury challenges scientific claims or asks what has not yet been validated.

presentation_rule: Main deck prioritizes clarity and persuasion. Technical completeness remains available in backup evidence.
